items.name: v0.7.0
items.body:
## Overview

llama.cpp v0.7.0 adds the LiliCorr speculative decoding technique and MTP for GLM5-Next, a new GPU cache for MoE experts kept in host memory (`--moe-cache-mib`, up to ~2.2x decode speedup when experts are offloaded), and a large batch of new models: K2 Horizon (dense and MoVA), Prism Bonsai 2 27B, EmbeddingGemma-2 (text+vision+audio), the LiquidAI d1/d1-omni and vLLM decision 2/d3 decision models, pplx-decider, MiniCPM-V 4.7, Nemotron Super 3.5 VL / Nemotron Bolt and maion-coder. The server gets a refactored chat session API (`common_chat_session`, part-based formatted output), much better slot and prompt-cache restore behavior, decision-model support for the new architectures and a new default port (9931), the web UI gains a full models manager, and ggml is updated to v0.27.0.

### Highlights

- New GPU cache for host-memory MoE experts (`--moe-cache-mib`): experts run on the GPU from an LRU cache, up to 2.2x faster decode [#29887](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29887)
- The expert cache is now shared across multiple GPUs [#30112](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30112)
- LiliCorr speculative decoding: candidate selection with a small draft transformer on top of DFlash [#30506](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30506)
- GLM5-Next: MTP speculative decoding with an optimized sparse attention path [#29928](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29928)
- K2 Horizon support in both dense and MoVA variants: conversion, tokenizer, chat template, `-sm tensor` splitting [#29535](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29535)
- Prism Bonsai 2 27B ternary model support [#29600](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29600)
- EmbeddingGemma-2: text + vision + audio embedding model [#30054](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp

items.name: Release v5.20.0
items.body: # Release v5.20.0 ## New Model additions ### Muse Spark Open Muse Spark Open is a multimodal mixture-of-experts model from Meta that takes text, images, audio, and video as input and generates text. It has 816B total parameters (42B active per token) and a context window of up to 1,048,576 tokens shared across modalities. It is trained for agentic coding tasks such as multi-file editing, debugging, and tool use. Checkpoints are available in BF16 and NVFP4 formats. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/muse_spark) | [Blog Post](http://hf.co/blog/meta-muse-spark-open) * Add Muse Spark Open (#49644) by @guarin in [#49644](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/49644) ### Ling 3.0 Ling 3.0 Flash is a hybrid Mixture-of-Experts language model from InclusionAI. Its decoder groups five Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) layers with one Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) layer. The MLA blocks use interleaved rotary embeddings and a head-wise output gate, and the feed-forward blocks combine routed and shared experts. It is natively supported in Transformers as `BailingHybridForCausalLM`, so it loads without `trust_remote_code=True`. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/bailing_hybrid) * [Model] Add native Ling 3.0 Flash support (#49446) by @icavan in [#49446](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/49446) ### Kolibri1 Kolibri 1 is Aleph Alpha's mixture-of-experts reasoning model, focused on German and English.
